'''Laerid Traehand''' is an [[Andoran]] noble of a minor House.

== Appearance ==
He is stocky.

== Activities ==
He is one of the nobles who have thrown their support behind [[Elayne Trakand]] and brought his armsmen to [[Caemlyn]].

When Elayne is captured by the [[Black Ajah]], he and his armsmen ride to aid [[Birgitte Silverbow]] in rescuing her.
